topics.title: Creating Christian content
topics.summary: Plan posts that serve a real need, point to Jesus and invite a next step.
topics.tip: Every post should answer: what do I want someone to do after seeing this?

topics.title: AI for Bible study
topics.summary: Use AI tools to find cross-references and questions, and always check them against Scripture and a mentor.
topics.tip: Treat AI answers as a starting point for study, never the final word.

topics.title: Short-form video
topics.summary: Reels, Shorts and TikToks of 30–60 seconds with one clear message.
topics.tip: Hook in the first 3 seconds, one idea, one call to action.

topics.title: Online Bible study
topics.summary: Run a simple, repeatable online study that people can join from anywhere in Korea.
topics.tip: Send the passage the day before so people can read ahead.

topics.title: Zoom ministry
topics.summary: Host warm online meetings: welcome people, use breakout rooms and follow up.
topics.tip: Have a co-host who greets newcomers by name in the chat.

topics.title: Social media evangelism
topics.summary: Move from comments to conversations to invitations, respectfully.
topics.tip: Reply to every sincere comment, and invite people to the community, not just to 'like'.

topics.title: Translation
topics.summary: Make content available in English, Tagalog and Korean.
topics.tip: Have a native speaker review translations before publishing.

topics.title: Digital community building
topics.summary: Build group chats that feel safe, friendly and purposeful.
topics.tip: Write simple group rules and appoint two moderators.

topics.title: Website ministry
topics.summary: Keep a simple website like this one up to date as your ministry's home base.
topics.tip: Add one new post each week; the feed sorts itself.

topics.title: Online discipleship
topics.summary: Walk with someone one-to-one using messages, calls and shared reading plans.
topics.tip: Online is the bridge: plan an in-person meeting as soon as you can.
